purpose: Move the deterministic 583-candidate fingerprint comparison into CI and publish a small content-addressed result that can be verified quickly by the diagnostic consumer.

must: compute every current price-blind taste fingerprint using the exact implementation contract
validate taste index structural shape and actual len(entries)
classify every feed candidate as exact cache hit or miss/stale
record exact counts and only non-hit details
bind result to exact Git tree/blob identities of all deterministic inputs

requires: exact candidate key exists in compact taste index
taste index profile_blob_sha equals the profile SHA already proven current by stage 04
taste index taste_model_version equals canonical policy model version
cached taste_fingerprint equals freshly computed current feed fingerprint

consumer_identity_inputs.mailing_tree_sha: reuse the exact current mailing tree identity already proven by stage 03; do not fetch it again inside stage 07
consumer_identity_inputs.mailing_index_blob_sha: reuse the exact current mailing index identity already proven by stage 03; do not fetch it again inside stage 07
consumer_identity_inputs.taste_index_blob_sha: reuse the exact current taste index identity already proven by stage 04; do not fetch it again inside stage 07
consumer_identity_inputs.profile_blob_sha: reuse the exact current canonical profile SHA already proven by stage 02/04; do not fetch it again inside stage 07
consumer_identity_inputs.fingerprint_contract_blob_sha: reuse the exact current fingerprint contract identity already proven by stage 06; do not fetch it again inside stage 07
consumer_identity_inputs.taste_model_version: reuse the canonical model version already proven from policy/stage 06

consumer_accept_only_if_all: validation mailing_tree_sha equals stage 03 current mailing_tree_sha
validation mailing_index_blob_sha equals stage 03 current mailing_index_blob_sha
validation taste_index_blob_sha equals stage 04 current taste_index_blob_sha
validation fingerprint_contract_blob_sha equals stage 06 current fingerprint_contract_blob_sha
validation profile_blob_sha equals current canonical profile SHA proven by stage 02/04
validation taste_model_version equals canonical policy taste model version
validation feed_candidate_count equals stage 03 current mailing item_count
validation hit_count plus miss_or_stale_count equals feed_candidate_count

consumer_runtime_rule.reason: The diagnostic runner already treats stages 03, 04 and 06 as prerequisites. Re-reading the same immutable identities inside stage 07 adds latency without adding proof strength.

failure_behavior.stale_or_mismatched_attestation: invalid; do not use counts; targeted retest must wait for/rebuild current validation artifact or fall back to direct full mechanical validation

diagnostic_stage_07.output_needed_for_stage_08: non_hits list only; confirmed hits are not semantically reevaluated
